text: **A flag isn't a root.** In an empty working directory, `deep hub start --root --typo` exits 2 and writes nothing. Today it exits 3 after writing `--typo/hub.key`, `--typo/hub.key.cert`, `--typo/control.token`, `--typo/hub-lock.sqlite` and `--typo/logs/hub.log` there. `deep hub status|stop|use --root --typo` exit 2 as well; today they exit 3, having written nothing. `deep hub run --root --typo` exits 2 and starts no server (not tried in #2200).

**A single dash is a flag too.** `deep status -x --why`, `deep env up --root -x` and `deep install -x` each exit 2 with nothing set up in a fresh home. Today the first two take `-x` as the session and the root; the third exits 2 only because no manifest is at `-x`.
**The other three.** `deep secret add --typo x`, `deep rules credit --typo` and `deep host changes --typo` each exit 2.
